description: A university-student adaptation of the Work Productivity and Activity Impairment: Special Health Problems questionnaire that measures self-rated academic performance impairment and mental-health-related study absenteeism over a 14-day recall period.
title: WPAI: SHP questionnaire adapted for academic performance impairment (API) in wartime students

description: A set of six MATLAB programs developed at Worcester Polytechnic Institute for teaching numerical one-dimensional quantum-mechanics problems and Dirac matrix formalism to undergraduate physics students.
title: WPI MATLAB exercise suite for 1D introductory quantum mechanics
